prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: automotive engineering concept presentation
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target. Image 2 is a geometry reference showing the governing +450 mm wheelbase extension and rear-axle position.
Primary request: in the UPPER three-quarter rear rendering only, make the +450 mm wheelbase extension visually unmistakable. Lengthen the car only in the body section between the fixed two-seat cabin/B-pillar and the rear axle. Move the complete rear wheel, rear wheel arch, rear quarter, rear bumper, engine deck and integrated 930 Turbo-inspired whale-tail assembly rearward together, while keeping the front half and cabin fixed. Create a clearly longer rear-quarter bridge between the trailing edge of the door/side intake and the rear wheel opening, with a stretched yet coherent prototype proportion. The new rear-wheel centre must align conceptually with the rear-axle datum shown in the lower cutaway and Image 2.
Invariants: preserve the LOWER transparent cutaway exactly as it is. Preserve the 930-style fixed whale-tail, its horizontal heat exchanger and ducting, the engine entirely ahead of the rear axle, transmission behind the axle, wheels and their design, body width, roof, glass, cabin, front wheel, front body, materials, colors, lighting, two-panel composition, paper background, existing labels and datum line. Do not enlarge the rear overhang alone: the visible extra length must occur ahead of the rear wheel, between cabin and axle.
Constraints: no tall pylon wing, no detached aerofoil, no GT3-style wing, no extra doors or seats, no long-tail extension behind the rear wheel, no logos, no watermark, no additional text. Keep the result as a plausible 993/930-inspired rear-mid-engine prototype, not a standard-wheelbase 911.
